sub_sector.value: casual dining sports bar restaurants; package liquor stores

product_category.detail: Casual dining, baby back ribs, wings, bar drinks, plus beer, wine and liquor at package stores.

market_position.detail: Casual family-run sports bars and restaurants emphasizing great value and happy hour specials.

distribution_model.detail: Company-owned restaurants and Big Daddy's liquor stores; some restaurants operated through limited partnerships; dine-in, bar and takeaway.

purchase_frequency.detail: Dining out and bar visits, with specials and rewards encouraging repeat visits.

notes: Franchise category is weak; Flanigan's mainly operates owned or partnership restaurants, with a few franchised units.
